note: Potential evidence gaps, not measurements. Statuses are derived from the data actually loaded. No source listed here was accessed by this project.

items.why_it_matters: Mean temperature anchors thermal-regime comparisons; max/min alone do not give the mean.
items.current_evidence: Columns loaded: date, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, WS2M, PS. T2M is not in the files; the pipeline reports its download failed. Do not derive it from T2M_MAX/T2M_MIN.
items.recommended_source: NASA POWER daily point API, parameter T2M (the parameter list in reports/power_parameter_availability.json lists it; it was not downloaded).
items.source_access: Recommended only. This project did not access this source.
items.cannot_conclude: Mean daily temperature, diurnal-mean statistics, any thermal analog claim.

items.why_it_matters: Surface thermal extremes drive mission design for hardware and power.
items.current_evidence: Manifest lists Moon temperature/solar as unavailable (Diviner not processed).
items.recommended_source: LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer products (NASA PDS Geosciences Node).
items.source_access: Recommended only. This project did not access this source.
items.cannot_conclude: Any thermal similarity between Earth cells and Taurus-Littrow.

items.variable: Verified Mars climate (temperature, pressure, wind, solar, humidity)
items.why_it_matters: Atmosphere controls dust, thermal cycling and entry/operations conditions.
items.current_evidence: Manifest lists Mars atmosphere as unavailable (MEDA not processed).
items.recommended_source: Mars 2020 MEDA environmental data (NASA PDS Atmospheres Node).
items.source_access: Recommended only. This project did not access this source.
items.cannot_conclude: Any atmospheric or climate analog claim for Jezero.

items.why_it_matters: Sun angle and shadow set power, thermal and imaging conditions.
items.current_evidence: No illumination dataset is registered in the site manifest.
items.recommended_source: LOLA-derived illumination products and LRO Camera imagery (NASA PDS / USGS Astrogeology).
items.source_access: Recommended only. This project did not access this source.

items.why_it_matters: Composition shapes dust, chemistry and science targets; terrain shape alone does not capture it.
items.current_evidence: Surface-characteristic layers are not implemented (README, DATASET_INVENTORY).
items.recommended_source: Mars: CRISM and Mars 2020 instrument data (PDS). Moon: LRO/Apollo sample and spectral products (PDS). Earth: geological maps.
items.source_access: Recommended only. This project did not access this source.
items.cannot_conclude: Whether any Earth cell is geologically similar.

items.variable: Soil / regolith properties (grain size, cohesion, rock abundance)
items.why_it_matters: Trafficability and excavation depend on soil mechanics.
items.current_evidence: No soil or regolith layer is in the processed data.
items.recommended_source: Moon: Apollo returned-sample data and Diviner rock abundance. Mars: rover traverse and thermal-inertia products. Earth: soil surveys.
items.source_access: Recommended only. This project did not access this source.
items.cannot_conclude: Rover mobility or excavation analog claims.

items.variable: Common vertical datum for absolute elevation
items.why_it_matters: Each body uses its own elevation zero, so absolute elevations are not comparable.
items.current_evidence: Elevation exists per body and is used for within-body terrain metrics only; the similarity model excludes it.
items.source_access: Recommended only. This project did not access this source.
items.cannot_conclude: Any cross-body comparison of absolute elevation.

items.variable: Representativeness of one reference site per body
items.why_it_matters: Jezero and Taurus-Littrow are single sites; scores describe closeness to them only.
items.current_evidence: One reference site per body; no external validation of the scores.
items.recommended_source: Additional reference sites and independent analog studies.
items.source_access: Recommended only. This project did not access this source.
items.cannot_conclude: That a high-scoring cell resembles Mars or the Moon in general.

items.why_it_matters: POWER values are modelled/satellite-derived for a grid cell, not station measurements.
items.current_evidence: Daily POWER records exist (n=365) for one point.
items.source_access: Recommended only. This project did not access this source.
